title: VP of Product Development

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: As Ricoh manufactures wide-format printers targeting the signage, vehicle wrap, and graphics markets, the VP of Product Development owns the product roadmap and strategic partnerships that enhance their printers' value proposition. Tedlar represents a critical opportunity for product differentiation - by partnering with or recommending Tedlar overlaminates, they can position their Pro L5160e and Pro TF6251 printers as complete solutions for customers demanding 12-20+ year outdoor durability. This role cares about competitive positioning against HP, Canon, and Epson in the large-format space, and being able to offer/recommend proven protective film solutions directly addresses customer pain points around UV degradation and warranty claims. Their KPIs include product portfolio performance, customer satisfaction scores, and market share growth in premium segments - all enhanced by associating Ricoh printers with industry-leading protective films. Given Ricoh's presence at PRINTING United and focus on serving 85% of Fortune 500 companies, this role would see Tedlar as a strategic enabler for premium market positioning and customer success.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: This role owns Ricoh's wide-format printer product roadmap, strategic partnerships, and go-to-market positioning for products like the Pro L5160e and Pro TF6251. They influence or directly approve partnerships that enhance product differentiation, customer value propositions, and competitive positioning against HP, Canon, and Epson. They likely report to a VP or SVP of Commercial & Industrial Printing, with product managers, technical specialists, and partnership managers reporting to them. Their strategic mandate includes expanding Ricoh's addressable market in premium graphics segments while protecting market share with Fortune 500 accounts.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: For this role, Tedlar's most relevant use cases center on completing Ricoh's solution portfolio: (1) Vehicle wraps and fleet graphics - enabling Ricoh printer customers to deliver graphics that withstand 12-20 years outdoors without fading or cracking, directly supporting warranty claims reduction; (2) Outdoor signage and architectural graphics - positioning Ricoh+Tedlar as the premium solution for exhibition graphics, POP displays, and building wraps where UV resistance is non-negotiable; (3) Transit and rail interiors - leveraging Tedlar's graffiti resistance and extreme temperature range to open new verticals for Ricoh's commercial printing customers. The benefit to this role is strategic: being able to position Ricoh printers as part of a complete, proven durability solution rather than just hardware, creating competitive separation and reducing customer total cost of ownership complaints.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This role is measured on product portfolio revenue growth, customer satisfaction scores (especially among Fortune 500 accounts), competitive win rates in premium segments, and product differentiation metrics. They personally care about solving the pain point where customers buy Ricoh printers but experience downstream failures due to inadequate protective films - leading to warranty disputes, brand damage, and churn to competitors. Tedlar's UV resistance and graffiti resistance directly address the number one customer complaint in outdoor graphics: premature degradation. By partnering with Tedlar, they can position Ricoh's Pro L5160e durability claims with third-party validation, reduce customer risk perception, and justify premium pricing through proven total cost of ownership advantages. This role's career advancement depends on demonstrating market leadership and innovation without massive R&D investment - Tedlar provides that leverage.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Ricoh showcased at PRINTING United Expo 2025 in Orlando (October 22-24), indicating active market positioning and likely preparing for 2026 product planning cycles. They've consistently exhibited at PRINTING United (2024 in Las Vegas, 2025 in Orlando), suggesting this is a key venue for announcing partnerships and product enhancements. Given typical annual planning cycles, Q1-Q2 2026 represents prime timing for partnership discussions that could be announced at PRINTING United Expo 2026. Additionally, Ricoh's focus on serving 85% of Fortune 500 companies means they're likely facing increasing pressure to differentiate on sustainability, durability, and total cost of ownership - areas where Tedlar provides immediate competitive advantage. The company's existing Sign & Graphics Professional Services training programs suggest infrastructure already exists to integrate Tedlar education and recommendations.

personalization_hooks.hook: Ricoh's Pro L5160e and Pro TF6251 emphasize outdoor durability, but customers face UV degradation and warranty challenges downstream when protective films fail prematurely
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Open by acknowledging Ricoh's leadership in print quality for outdoor applications, then position Tedlar as the missing piece that ensures customers realize the full value of their Ricoh investment over 12-20 years rather than replacing graphics every 3-5 years

personalization_hooks.hook: VP of Product Development owns competitive differentiation against HP, Canon, and Epson in the large-format printer market where specs increasingly commoditize
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame Tedlar partnership as a strategic positioning opportunity - Ricoh becomes the only manufacturer offering a complete durability solution backed by 60+ years of proven performance, creating meaningful competitive separation beyond print speed and resolution

personalization_hooks.hook: Ricoh serves 85% of Fortune 500 companies who increasingly demand sustainability, reduced maintenance costs, and validated performance claims for outdoor graphics
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Position Tedlar as the enterprise-grade solution that helps Ricoh defend and expand Fortune 500 accounts by addressing CFO-level concerns around total cost of ownership, fewer replacements, and reduced environmental impact from premature graphic disposal

recommended_approach: Lead with competitive differentiation angle, emphasizing how Tedlar partnership enables Ricoh to own the complete outdoor graphics solution rather than just printing hardware. Frame this as a strategic product portfolio conversation, not a vendor pitch - focus on how this enhances their Pro L5160e and Pro TF6251 positioning at PRINTING United 2026 and with Fortune 500 accounts. Reference their existing Sign & Graphics Professional Services infrastructure as a natural integration point for Tedlar education and recommendations.
